name: Vakataka Kingdom
events: Wootz steel is developed in India (approximate date).
King Chandragupta I founds the Gupta dynasty in northern India (approximate date).
In India, Samudragupta of the Gupta Empire defeats Rudrasena in battle.
In India, a new process makes possible the extraction of sugar from sugarcane.
The Ajanta Caves (India) are completed (cut into the volcanic rock and elaborately painted).
Buddhist caves are completed at Ajanta (India) with stone carvings (approximate date).
Yasodharman, Maharaja ("great king") of Malwa, defeats the Hun invaders under Mihirakula in central India.
